formal_statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∀ i : Fin 4, ∑ j, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 5, ∑ i, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, if j = l then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, if a < b then t (a, j) * t (b, l) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ l = m then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, ∑ c : Fin 4, if a < b ∧ b < c then t (a, j) * t (b, l) * t (c, m) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, ∑ n, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ j = n ∨ l = m ∨ l = n ∨ m = n then 0 else t (0, j) * t (1, l) * t (2, m) * t (3, n)) = 0) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 5
plain_statement: There is a linear space L of 4 x 5 complex matrices of dimension 5 such that, for every t in L, every row and every column of t sums to zero and the sums of all 2 x 2, all 3 x 3 and all 4 x 4 subpermanents of t vanish. The largest such space known has dimension 4, a mode core; finite-field searches found none of dimension 5. This is a search and may well have no witness.
title: SEARCH: a doubly centred level space of 4 x 5 matrices of dimension 5 (open; none known)
